description: This Java source file defines a test suite named EntityQueryTestSuite for testing various query functionalities of the EntityQuery API in the Apache OFBiz framework. It contains multiple test methods covering query count, filtering with conditions, ordering, distinct selection, iteration, and caching mechanisms for entity data.

classes.name: EntityQueryTestSuite
classes.description: Test suite class for testing various entity query operations in the OFBiz framework. Extends EntityTestCase and includes multiple test methods to verify behavior of the EntityQuery API.

methods.name: testQueryCount
methods.description: Tests the queryCount() method of EntityQuery to ensure it returns the correct number of records matching a query.

methods.name: testWhere
methods.description: Verifies the where() method's filtering capability by comparing results fetched via EntityEngine and EntityQuery.

methods.name: testQueryList
methods.description: Checks whether queryList() returns all matching records, comparing EntityEngine and EntityQuery results.

methods.name: testQueryFirst
methods.description: Ensures queryFirst() retrieves the first record correctly and matches between EntityEngine and EntityQuery.

methods.name: testQueryOne
methods.description: Verifies that queryOne() retrieves a single expected record based on given conditions.

methods.name: testQueryOneWithContext
methods.description: Tests queryOne() resolving parameters and context maps to fetch expected records.

methods.name: testSelect
methods.description: Checks the select() method to fetch only specified fields from an entity.

methods.name: testDistinctAndSelect
methods.description: Validates distinct() combined with select() for retrieving unique field values.

methods.name: testOrderBy
methods.description: Verifies that orderBy() sorts answer sets as intended.

methods.name: testFilterByDate
methods.description: Tests filterByDate() to fetch active records based on date fields.

methods.name: testMaxRows
methods.description: Checks maxRows() limits the number of fetched records appropriately.

methods.name: testFetchSize
methods.description: Verifies fetchSize() sets the fetch window size for queries.

methods.name: testQueryIterator
methods.description: Validates iterator-based query execution produces consistent results.

methods.name: testCursorForwardOnly
methods.description: Tests cursor type setting to forward-only and verifies first record retrieval.

methods.name: testCache
methods.description: Ensures query caching works correctly, avoiding redundant data fetches.
